quests.title: Feed the Hands That Haul
quests.text: The next load to the front needs provisions for the people hauling it. Bring me five Ember Eel, and I will see the cooks pack them into something fit for the journey. If a carrier has to eat the contents of the load to reach its destination, I have provisioned the wrong end of the trip.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft TH1; the Throng's capital share of the 41-50 pattern.

quests.title: Ready at the Water Depot
quests.text: Our next front load is tied up at the cook court's water depot here in Gor Drazhak, waiting for its final check. Inspect the prepared supplies and release the load there. I promised those crews something useful would arrive; help me send it while they still have a use for it.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft TH2: the town place of Gor Drazhak's cook court (chapter 1's, another object and label).

quests.title: A Fang Through the Strap
quests.text: The people making our carrying gear ought to see what bites through it. Bring me three Siegepack Fangs; Siegepack Hyenas prowl the {name:front_shattered_line/trenches} by day. I want the next discussion about a stronger strap to include the tooth that broke the last one.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft TH3 (K7 A): the item only, no kill count (a mob drop: still a fight); Gor Drazhak's weapon (a solo quest). The Sinkmire Viper hunt, a camp hunt's role, is gone.

quests.title: Optional: Watch Where You Land
quests.text: Visitors to Stormscale Summit spend too long looking at the skyline and too little watching their feet. I am offering a bounty on six Kraits in the {name:front_stormscale_summit/scorchlands}, where they hunt by day. Take a boat to the island and keep your attention on what can reach your ankles.
quests.lesson: An island bounty: coin, no leveling.
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft TH4 (K9 A): the Throng's island bounty, another mob than the Accord's (the check: glass_fang_serpent reads 'Krait' on Stormscale); weight 0, copper like the Accord's.

quests.title: Party: Nothing More to Offer
quests.text: {name:last_offering_ape} is making the {name:front_stormscale_summit/thunderwood} on Stormscale Summit dangerous for anyone trying to pass through. Gather a group, take a boat each to the island and kill that elite ape, {dir_from_giver:last_offering_ape}. This is work for a party with a plan; a lone visitor is only giving it another reason to stay.
quests.lesson: An island bounty: coin, no leveling.
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft TH5 (K9 A): the bounty's one follow-up, the island elite (a recorded exception: the island elites stay per faction, plan §2 point 4).

quests.title: Optional: Sink the Wages
quests.text: There is branded pay in the wreck at {name:r20_anchor_086} on Stormscale Summit, waiting for a salvage crew to call it wages. Take a boat from the Shipwright and give the wreck's pay to the sea before anyone accepts it. The sea already has the sailors; it can keep their money too.

objectives.label: Give the wreck's pay to the sea

quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft TH6: the optional island use, free from 60 without a story prerequisite.
